profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer LMTS at Salesforce
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with strong information technology professional skilled in Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), Helping Clients Succeed, Solution Architecture, and Communicating to stake holders.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer SMTS
positions.description: Skills: Threat Modeling · Security Controls · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Cloud Security · Automation · Design Review · Defining Requirements · Cloud Infrastructure · Technical Documentation · Risk Assessment · Presentations · Data Privacy · Communication · Vulnerability Assessment

positions.title: Software Engineer MTS
positions.description:
Performed Agile Development of an in-house web application (product) for automating systems, troubleshooting and recovery using Python and PowerShell
• Product integrated via REST API with:
o CyberArk Integration for secrets management
o Incident management for ticket, Changes in Salesforce
o Confluence, Gitlab and GitHub for documentation
o Okta for Authentication (OIDC and SAML)
o Monitoring with Grafana, NewRelic and Splunk
DevOps solution for automation with Ansible Tower and one-off playbooks. 
Secure API with Mulesoft
Manage and participate on Team On-Call/Paging Schedule with PagerDuty alerts and automation
Manage and Maintain On-Call responsibilities/processes 
Collaborated with Operational teams to support services and train them to support the services. 
Develop cross-team relationships to help move forward the business and weed out wasted resources 
Performed Windows and Linux server administration tasks extensively during the server patching and systems troubleshooting.
Help team members organize to complete projects and unblock obstacles from external teams. 
• Stack ranking task in each project to identify priorities
• Organize requests from external teams and provide ETA on the next step from their requirements.
• Help team members with scoping and deadlines to keep project on time
• Present RACI to Upper management and Program management teams
• Provide update on projects process to Upper management and set expectation of completion or delays
• Help external teams understand SLA on request for either new features or operational work on the team.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Identity Service Ownership
•	Architecture
o	Integrations between services and communicate how Okta, CyberArk and Active Directory are managed to the Architecture review board
o	Manage designs to be presented to Program teams for CRUD, Onboard and sustainability of our services
•	Okta
o	RestAPI via PowerShell and Python to perform automated operational tasks
o	Java for on-prem SCIM server to support Snowflake for Role based/Least Privileged User Access Management
o	Splunk for monitor and alerts via Slack
•	Active Directory
o	Work with operations team to support tier 1/2 tasks and work to automate repeated tasks
o	Upgrade environment
•	CyberArk Secrets Management for Identities
o	Automate with Ansible to build infrastructure 
o	Use RestAPI with PowerShell and Python to build safes and manage access with least privilege
o	Intake new feature by understanding User’s use case
Documentation via Gitlab or Confluence to be used by either the internal team or by customers.
Create and maintain code in Gitlab to upload service information to Snowflake. 
•	Validate testing of code
•	Monitor tasks are running
•	Least Privileged access to services for upload to Snowflake
•	Python and PowerShell with RestAPI to pull information from Okta, CyberArk, Active Directory, and push to Snowflake
•	Tableau Viz with source Snowflake used to show dashboards to management and Customers.  The dashboard helps visualize data needed by the team to understand how they are using our services.
positions.insights: Skills: Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Automation · Cloud Infrastructure · Technical Documentation · Presentations · Data Privacy · Communication

positions.title: Desktop Support Lead
positions.description:
Create Documentation for team usage and for customers.  
Automate operational task when see fit
Manage training room with automated imaging
•	O/S: Suse, Ubuntu, CentOS, Solaris, Windows server, and Windows client
•	Created new images to support development testing of the product or for training classes
•	Troubleshoot issues with product and O/S
Manage hardware and software licensing for users.

Documented solutions and maintained internal knowledge base and intranet site. Trained and mentored new and existing employees on new and updated software functionality. Worked with IT to mitigate the impact of critical configuration errors, virus outbreaks, and related urgent matters. Administered corporate training facilities, leveraging images to mass-configure systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Automation · Technical Documentation · Data Privacy

positions.title: Service Desk Tech.
positions.description: Fielded support calls from both employees and clients in the region. Created procedural documentation to define core processes. Maintained hardware and software inventorying data. Utilized HP Open View to manage and monitor services in order to meet SLA. Maintained user accounts in Active Directory.

positions.title: Corporate Help Desk
positions.description: Received support calls and email using BMC Remedy ticketing system. Managed high call volumes, efficiently escalating and re-routing issues accordingly. Maintained hardware and software resources for internal employees. Managed elements of end-user security infrastructure, including secure VPN access and RSA security tokens.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: Assembled, tested, and repaired server, desktop, and laptop hardware. Performed server backups to tape, following tape rotation cycles. Maintained a hybrid Windows and Linux environment responsible for surface-to-air communications. Fielded support requests for Asia/Pacific region via telephone and email. Configured and maintained video conferencing equipment for cross-continental communications
